result:
`bun tools/check-register.ts` reports no unsettled risk at Likelihood 3 or higher. It read 436 items and found 0 in each of its four categories: unsettled at Likelihood 3+, settled with no Verified line, Moved Out for a live reason, and two Likelihood values.

38 of those items have more than one Status line and Likelihood 3 or higher. The checker reads only the last Status line, so each entry below shows that one. I extracted them with my own throwaway script, not the checker. All 38 end settled.

**setup.md**
- RISK-401 (L5): mitigated 2026-11-18. Routine writes meet no EPERM with the ADR-0188 block.
- RISK-410 (L4): closed. It is outside claudetto (OUT-866, ADR-0190), "as the first Status line says".
- RISK-411 (L3): mitigated 2026-11-19. The session-start fill removes the retired text. It runs in the hook, outside the Bash sandbox.

**cost.md**
- RISK-374 (L5): mitigated 2026-11-18. The spawn-depth and concurrency caps take effect, and Opus and Fable spawns are refused.
- RISK-391 and RISK-393 (L3, same text): mitigated 2026-11-19.
  - The fill writes no `Bash(claude -p *)` allow and removes the one earlier versions wrote, so a paid run meets the normal permission prompt.
  - An earlier status of 2026-11-19 had accepted the risk on ADR-0188's allow rule. The entry says that acceptance was the user's to give and was withdrawn.

**reply.md**
- RISK-226 (L4), RISK-262, 264, 352, 353 and 362 (L5), and RISK-278 (L4): mitigated 2026-11-19. The defect paragraph in `output-styles/claudetto.md` beats vanilla on two fixtures and holds level on both controls.
- RISK-227 (L3): mitigated 2026-11-19. The output style plus the redact guard beat vanilla on two fixtures (env1 5/6 vs 1/6, env2 6/6 vs 0/6) and hold level on both controls.
- RISK-497 (L4): mitigated 2026-11-19. Line 3 beats vanilla on the tuning fixture (6/6 vs 0/6) and on an untouched one (4/6 vs 0/6). It holds the control at 6/6 on Opus, Sonnet and Haiku.

**delegation.md**
- RISK-166 (L4): closed 2026-11-19. It was not reproduced on vanilla 2.1.327, and the BUILD line is superseded.
- RISK-169 (L4): closed.
  - The cure was a SubagentStop/Stop guard, and run limits and Stop checks were removed (ADR-0092, OUT-016).
  - Likelihood stays 4 as accepted engine behaviour, because a job dies with the turn.
- RISK-170 (L4), RISK-199 (L3) and RISK-223 (L4): mitigated 2026-11-18 by the shipped agent files.
- RISK-171 (L4): mitigated 2026-11-19. The consent paragraph in the output style and the Artemis, Athena and Heracles agent files beat vanilla on r171b and r171d and hold level on both controls.
- RISK-185 (L3): mitigated 2026-11-19. The output-style paragraph that has the agent read a background command's output before replying beats vanilla on r185a and r185b and holds level on the r185c control.
- RISK-186 (L5): mitigated 2026-11-19 (bb4fdbf4, RISK-499, issue #45).
  - The rebuild's own Bash wrapper made every git command in an isolated worktree non-simple, so each was refused. A command naming git is now left unwrapped.
  - A residual remains: model-written expansions that no hook reaches. Likelihood stays 5 for them, with Impact 2.
- RISK-222 (L4): mitigated 2026-11-18. `CLAUDE_CODE_SUBAGENT_MODEL` moves a no-model subagent off Opus.

**guards.md**
- RISK-053 (L4): mitigated 2026-11-19, with a gap closed.
  - The paths `~/./`, `~//` and `~/x/..`, and an unclosed `[` (which threw and failed the guard open), passed the wall guard for a sandbox-off call (#42).
  - The guard now folds those paths and escapes `[`. `wall.test.ts` covers all four, and each half of the fix fails it when reverted.
- RISK-055 (L4): closed 2026-11-19. pkill and killall ask first, and the free-memory hold gates heavy calls.
- RISK-059 (L3): closed 2026-11-18. The gate texts that handed commands to the user are dropped (OUT-035, OUT-021), and a grep for them finds no hit.
- RISK-063 (L3): closed 2026-11-19. Destructive git and the user settings file ask first.
- RISK-064 (L4): closed 2026-11-19. The deny rules and the sandbox are the boundary.
- RISK-067 (L4): mitigated 2026-11-19 for git only.
  - The ask rules cover stash, hard reset, clean and `branch -D`, including the `git -C dir` form.
  - For rm, Claude Code 2.1.327 refuses dangerous removals on its own.
  - The disk-cleanup part has no control and rests on one report. The entry records a residual likelihood of 2.
- RISK-071 (L5): closed 2026-11-18. The `rules.ts` stat and the gate denial log are dropped with the gate (OUT-035), and a grep finds no hit.
- RISK-103 (L4): mitigated 2026-11-19. `rules.ts` adds middle-wildcard forms, and a fake-API probe denied all seven force-push and stash forms tried.

**verification.md**
- RISK-424 (L3): mitigated 2026-11-18. The threshold test pins the literal 70000.
- RISK-451 (L4): mitigated 2026-11-19. The output-style paragraph on background exit status beats vanilla on r451a and r451d and holds level on the r451c control.
- RISK-462 (L4): moved Out as OUT-2777 (Verified line).
- RISK-463 (L3): closed 2026-11-19. The fault stayed out of 24 of 24 target runs on two fixtures, vanilla and claudetto.

**edit.md**
- RISK-416 (L5): mitigated 2026-11-19. One line in the output style and `agents/Heracles.md` asks for one `perl -pi` call when a change repeats across files. The first edit method was perl in 3 of 3 runs, and every run renamed all 4 files. The entry says the perl allow rules are needed, since the same call is denied without them.

**handover.md**
- RISK-132 (L4): mitigated 2026-11-19 for options the user refused, because the handover keeps every user correction, refusal and consent word for word. For an option the agent ruled out alone, the risk is accepted, and the next session rechecks it against the code.

Four of these entries have a last Status line that doesn't give a plain reason on its own. RISK-410's refers back to the first Status line, RISK-462 points to OUT-2777, RISK-067 is mitigated for git only, and RISK-186 keeps a residual at Likelihood 5. If you want a second look at any of them, those are the four to start with.
